description: Simulated flying laps (s) on the stock AI line with the stock brake line settings: grip 1.0, the tables' middle mass, difficulty 1.0, standard fuel map, medium ERS (the 1990 car has none). lap1990: the generated 1990 tables (handling removed_2026_1990). lap2026: the stock tables of the same folder at that track. lap1990_race: the 1990 tables at grip AI_RACE_GRIP (0.87, the race tyre), the modifiers at 1.0. ratio = lap1990 / lap2026. model_ratio: both cars from the car model (1990 before the copd correction against the 2026 car), for comparison.
